name: brigadier
description: Hand coding work to the brigadier CLI running locally on this machine.
long_description: Claude Desktop Skills execute server-side and cannot invoke a binary on your laptop. Desktop MCP servers run locally with full user privileges and can spawn `claude -p`. That is why brigadier reaches Desktop as an MCP server rather than as a skill: it is the only surface that can actually start a run.

tools.name: brigadier_validate_plan
tools.description: Check a brigadier plan document for shape defects and scheduling defects, and report the dependency waves it would run in. Touches nothing.

tools.name: brigadier_route_plan
tools.description: Report which vendor, model, and effort this machine would give each slice of a plan, or why no model can take it. Creates no worktree and spawns no worker.

tools.name: brigadier_run
tools.description: Run a brigadier plan on a local repository: route every slice, spawn a worker for each, commit what it produced, and merge the lot.
